# Number Spinner
> Free, browser-based random wheel and number-selection tools. This optional directory links to published, human-readable pages. It is not a ranking or AI indexing signal.

## Interactive tools
- [Custom Spin the Wheel](https://numberspinner.com/): Enter your own names or choices; optionally adjust weights, remove winners and share configurations.
- [Random Number Wheel](https://numberspinner.com/random-number-wheel/): Choose a whole-number range, excluded numbers, step, batch size and repetition rule.
- [Random Number 1–100](https://numberspinner.com/random-number-wheel/1-100/): Instantly generate 1–100 results or animate the same selection.
- [Random Number 1–3](https://numberspinner.com/random-number-wheel/1-3/)
- [Random Number 1–4](https://numberspinner.com/random-number-wheel/1-4/)
- [Random Number 1–5](https://numberspinner.com/random-number-wheel/1-5/)
- [Random Number 1–6](https://numberspinner.com/random-number-wheel/1-6/)
- [Random Number 1–20](https://numberspinner.com/random-number-wheel/1-20/)

## Explanations and policies
- [All tools](https://numberspinner.com/tools/): Select a tool by task.
- [Methodology](https://numberspinner.com/about/): Browser Web Crypto, unbiased integer draws, weights, repeats and limitations, with code links.
- [Privacy policy](https://numberspinner.com/privacy/): Local processing, browser storage and link-sharing risks.
- [Contact and corrections](https://numberspinner.com/contact/)

This is not an independently audited or certified lottery or regulated prize-drawing service. The visible tool pages take precedence over this directory.
